knowledge:
- key_parameters: distfile=Path to the distance matrix file generated from a pplacer placefile using placeutil ;; placefile=Path to the pplacer JSON output file ;; refpkg=Path to the reference package directory ;; seqnames=Sequence names to order the taxonomy, typically matching the rownames of the tree distance matrix ;; lowest_rank=The most specific taxonomic rank to consider (e.g., 'species') ;; cutoff=Distance threshold from the centermost sequence to define outliers ;; quant=Quantile of all pairwise distances to define the outlier threshold ;; idx=Indices of sequences that must be included in maxDists (e.g., type strains) ;; N=Number of sequences to select for the diverse subset in maxDists ;; exclude=Logical vector indicating sequences to exclude (e.g., outliers) in maxDists ;; include.center=Logical indicating whether to include the centermost sequence in maxDists
- alternatives: clst::classifyIter=classifyPlacements is a wrapper around clst::classifyIter ;; ape::plot.tree=clstutils::prettyTree extends ape::plot.tree to facilitate annotation of outliers and selected subsets on phylogenetic trees
- when_to_use: Use when performing taxonomic classification of query sequences placed on a phylogenetic tree using pplacer outputs, or when curating reference sequence sets by identifying taxonomic outliers (mislabeled sequences) and selecting representative diverse subsets.
- pitfalls: Failing to identify and exclude outliers before selecting a diverse subset using maxDists can result in primarily selecting outlier (mislabeled) sequences ;; The distance matrix file (distfile) must be generated from the placefile using placeutil (distributed with pplacer) before running treeDists.

workflows.name: taxonomic_classification
workflows.intent: Classify query sequences placed on a phylogenetic tree using pplacer outputs and a reference package.
input: distfile (distance matrix file generated from placefile using placeutil)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate tree distances using treeDists ;; 2. Retrieve taxonomic information from the reference package using taxonomyFromRefpkg ;; 3. Define query placement data ;; 4. Classify placements using classifyPlacements
workflows.code:
treedists <- treeDists(distfile=distfile, placefile=placefile)
taxdata <- taxonomyFromRefpkg(refpkg, seqnames=rownames(treedists$dmat), lowest_rank='species')
placetab <- data.frame(at=49, edge=5.14909e-07, branch=5.14909e-07)
cdata <- classifyPlacements(taxdata, treedists, placetab)

workflows.name: reference_set_curation
workflows.intent: Identify taxonomic outliers and select a maximally diverse subset of reference sequences.
input: seqs (DNAbin object representing a multiple sequence alignment)
seqdat (data.frame containing taxonomic assignments of the sequences)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate pairwise DNA distances using ape::dist.dna ;; 2. Identify outlier sequences using findOutliers ;; 3. Visualize outliers on a phylogenetic tree using prettyTree ;; 4. Select a diverse subset of sequences using maxDists while excluding outliers ;; 5. Visualize the selected subset on the tree using prettyTree
workflows.code:
dmat <- ape::dist.dna(seqs[Efaecium,], pairwise.deletion=TRUE, as.matrix=TRUE, model='raw')
outliers <- clstutils::findOutliers(dmat, cutoff=0.015)
prettyTree(nj(dmat), groups=ifelse(outliers,'outlier','non-outlier'),
           X=outliers, labels=ifelse(isType,gettextf('type strain (%s)', accession),NA))
selected <- clstutils::maxDists(dmat, idx=which(isType),
                                N=10, exclude=outlier, include.center=TRUE)
prettyTree(nj(dmat), groups=ifelse(outlier,'outlier','non-outlier'),
           X=outlier,
           O=selected, fill=selected,
           labels=ifelse(isType,gettextf('type strain (%s)', accession),NA))
